The constitution is complete and validated. Let me record a minimal persistent handoff note (explicitly allowed by the task) so later phases have the deferred implementation intent, then close the phase.

{"action":"shell","command":"cd /testbed && cat > HANDOFF.md <<'EOF'
# HANDOFF

## Phase: constitution (complete)
- Artifact: `.specify/memory/constitution.md` v1.0.0 (ratified 2026-10-17).
- Five approved principles: (I) preserve existing public API behavior, (II)
  testable acceptance criteria, (III) evidence over assertion, (IV) simple
  scoped implementations, (V) documented assumptions and regressions.
- Template resolved via `python3 .specify/scripts/python/resolve_template.py
  constitution-template --json`; no `.specify/extensions.yml` present, so no
  pre/post hooks applied. Validation observed: no unexplained bracket tokens,
  version line matches Sync Impact Report, ISO dates present.
- Scope guard: application implementation was NOT started in this phase.

## Deferred intent (for later phases)
- tinydb milestone 1: implement `tinydb.journal.BatchWriter(db)` in
  `tinydb/journal.py` per R01-R03 (atomic batch apply on `_default` table,
  insert/remove ops, ValueError on malformed ops, rollback restores complete
  pre-batch default-table data, no aliasing of caller input). Feature
  directory: `/testbed/specs/001-transactions`. Public acceptance:
  `acceptance_public.py`; upstream tests unchanged. Suggested next command:
  `$speckit-specify`.
EOF
git status --short | head; echo '---'; ls -la .specify/memory/"}
